correctness.rationale: Proof checks: B_k-1 recovers number of blocks; strict supermultiplicativity B_(p+q-1)>B_p B_q singles out one-nonsingleton-block types; a!=b gives a nonzero (t-1)(b-a) two-sided coarsening difference for pure subsets; round three reads C(u,2),C(v,2) for mixed subset profiles; round four reads all bivariate binomial moments, with degree 0 and 1 supplied by number of blocks and fixed a,b, so exact profile multiplicities follow by an invertible basis change. The stabilizer S_a x S_b is transitive on each recovered class, proving orbit equality. Both independent finite scripts passed with 9/12 tested parameter cases, without replacing the general proof.

value.rationale: The exact reconstruction of the asymmetric two-block landmark stabilizer orbits in a universal constant four rounds is a structural result over a Bell-number-sized family of natural nondistributive lattices. It requires combining asymmetric side detection with bivariate binomial inversion and yields exact orbit-count and orbit-size formulas for every a>b>=1. It does not follow routinely from the unmarked block-size classification: the latter contains no information about joint intersections with a fixed two-block partition. The bound is not asserted sharp and identification beyond the given structure is not claimed.
